frozen_question: On the complete 4,520-state exact G6:S1 child universe, with C3 used only as the certified exact-state upper bound, what is the exact one-more-composition behavior kernel under the registered ordinary continuation observer? Does the first deterministic ordinary context already separate all exact states, are more registered contexts required, or does a nontrivial full one-step quotient remain?

independent_verification.method: Independent manual cross-edge construction plus independent unrooted canon recomputes every context used by the selected ladder for the deterministic sample and requires exact structural signature equality with the primary implementation.
independent_verification.sample_rule: 128 exact S1 states with lexicographically smallest SHA-256 of exact structural canon; hashes only select the deterministic sample.

promotion_constraints: No S2R result promotes C3 or any hidden topology/canon to the G6 public descriptor.
A discrete kernel is a scoped necessity/separation result on the frozen 4,520-state universe, not a global theorem.
A nontrivial L3 quotient is candidate-only input for a newly frozen repaired S3 registration.
The old unrepaired G6:S2/G6:S3 chain is not resumed automatically.

test_protocol.candidate_binding: Bind to the certified G6:S1R C3 result on exactly that universe. C3 is not promoted and need not be recomputed as a scientific decision in S2R.
test_protocol.decision_equality: Full canonical structural tuples only. SHA-256 may index evidence and select deterministic samples but never decides scientific equality.
test_protocol.full_quotient_rule: If L3 still contains non-singleton classes, those classes are the exact full registered one-step behavior quotient on the frozen universe and must be preserved structurally.
test_protocol.monotonicity_rule: If a subset of the registered observer is injective, every superset observer is injective; therefore S2R may stop at the first ladder level whose classes are all singleton.
test_protocol.partition_refinement: Start with all exact states unresolved. At each ladder level, evaluate only states still in non-singleton classes, append the newly registered continuation contexts, and split classes by full structural exact relation signatures.
test_protocol.universe: Regenerate all exact S1 children from the frozen S0 basis and all 31 operators; deduplicate by full exact unrooted structural canon; require exact count and universe SHA from G6:S1R.
